content: $\bullet $ An entity $e_i$ is a set of $J_i$ unordered records $\lbrace r_{i,1}, ..., r_{i,j}, ..., r_{i,J_i}\rbrace $; where record $r_{i,j}$ is defined as a pair of key $k_{i,j}$ and value $v_{i,j}$. We outline that $J_i$ might differ between entities.
